title: Dynamic licensing scorecard and staged rollout gating for model onboarding
creator: Anika Rao
description:
Problem: New model uploads occasionally contain ambiguous or encumbered weight artifacts (e.g., redistributed checkpoints, mixed-license components) that should not be published or served until an explicit legal/engineering clearance is obtained. Current onboarding UX requires large manual effort and late-stage blocking by Legal, which slows time-to-availability and increases risk of accidental serving of non-compliant models.

Objective: Build an automated, auditable license/compliance scoring pipeline and a staged gating workflow that prevents publishing and performance-profile propagation for models that score below a policy threshold. The pipeline should produce a human-readable scorecard (license compatibility, provenance, presence of restricted blobs, signature status) and surface required remediation steps. For borderline cases, the system should allow temporary quarantines and controlled canary rollouts after escrow/mitigation steps.

Scope: license compatibility heuristics, restricted-weight binary detection (hash-based and heuristic), manifest/signature validation, dynamic scorecard computation, UI gating in Console and API-level flags to prevent performance profile publication and hosted serving until clearance, integration with Legal and Security review queues, and audit trail generation.
acceptance_criteria: Automated pipeline inspects uploaded model bundles and produces a scorecard JSON with fields: license_score (0-100), provenance_flag, restricted_blob_count, signature_status, recommended_action.
Models with license_score < 70 are automatically quarantined; quarantine blocks publishing to public catalog and blocks performance-profile publishing to the runtime catalog.
A Console work item is created for quarantined models with prefilled remediation checklist and attachable artifacts (diff of LICENSEs, provenance log).
Legal & Security can mark a quarantined model as 'cleared' via Console; clearing unblocks publish and triggers a change log entry with reviewer name and timestamp.

Edge-case: If restricted_blob_count > 0, system must allow temporary escrow token issuance that enables private-serving test tokens for customer VPCs only, but never public hosted serving until explicit Legal approval.
All pipeline runs are recorded in an append-only audit log accessible via API for 365 days.
tasks: Draft PRD describing scorecard fields, threshold rationale, and legal review flow (owner: PM)
Implement detection service (ENG) for restricted binaries: file signature scanning, entropy checks, known-hash blacklist lookup
Build license compatibility engine that maps SPDX and common text licenses to a compatibility score (Research + Legal)
Console UX: quarantined model state, remediation checklist, manual clearance button, and visibility of scorecard
API: add upload-time response with scorecard and 'quarantine_reason' code; surface 'clearance_required' flag
Integration: create Legal review queue webhook and Slack notifications; attach model bundle link + scorecard
Audit trail: append-only logs and export endpoint for compliance audits
E2E tests: synthetic model bundles covering common license combos and encumbered payloads
Docs: public-facing onboarding guidance and internal runbook for triage
risks: False positives could delay legitimate model availability and frustrate upstream partners
Aggressive heuristics risk over-blocking binary blobs derived from open-source sources with non-standard packaging
Legal capacity to triage quarantines may be a bottleneck; need SLAs and possible escalation path
Performance: scanning large model bundles must not significantly increase upload latency beyond acceptable limits
